CIV.note: Programme is for young people and students, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The Prime Minister launched the GENIE project on 26 February 2025, under which 35 DigiGreen centres in schools, universities and town halls in Abidjan and Grand-Bassam are to train over 45,000 young people in digital skills, co-financed at 5.5 billion FCFA by the government, KOICA and GGGI.

CIV.note: Centres in town halls are learning centres for the public; no office connection stated.
Learning centres are for training; incubation and a fund are only planned.
